maya (product): Quick sync — after yesterday's capacity fallback we need a small PRD update + runbook additions. Customers hit degraded responses when fallback routing kicked in. Want to capture acceptance criteria and launch guardrails before next rollout. :eyes:

alex (eng): Agreed. What specifically should be mandatory vs. recommended?

maya (product): Mandatory: automated canary (5% traffic, 10m min), explicit fallback mapping to compatible model variants, and SLA-driven throttling thresholds. Recommended: automated KV cache warmup on canary, preflight quantization checks.

tariq (sre): Add runbook steps for detection + mitigation. If fallback rate > 2% sustained for 5m, escalate to oncall and trigger fallback rollback. Include command snippets.

sophia (oncall): I'll draft the exact runbook commands. For rollback we need: model_pin, route_override, and capacity_drain. Example: 
```
# rollback snippet
redwoodctl routes override --route prd-textgen --to model:v1.2 --duration 30m
redwoodctl model pin --name prd-textgen --version v1.2
```

maya (product): Nice. Acceptance criteria in PRD should be explicit and testable:
- Canary succeeds: 95th latency within 20% of baseline and no quality regression on sample set
- Fallback quality check: end-to-end smoke eval passes on top-10 prompts
- Rollback works via automated script and manual path

alex (eng): For the quality regression check we should pin the eval harness commit and include a small dataset (50 prompts) that must pass. If any model variant fails more than 3 prompts we mark canary failed.

tariq (sre): Edge cases: network partitions between control plane and private deployments — runbook must include manual routing via customer VPC NAT if API can't reach control plane. Also add KMS key check for private deploys to avoid auth failures during rollback.

maya (product): Prioritization request: this is a P1 for Dedicated/Private customers who saw the outage, P2 for general hosted rollout. We need scope negotiation: can we land the mandatory items in next sprint?

alex (eng): Next sprint is tight. We can do: canary infra + rollback scripts as part of the sprint, but the KV warmup and eval harness integration will be follow-up. Need an RFC for the policy config schema (canary.percent, thresholds, fallback_variant_map).

sophia (oncall): I'll own the runbook doc and add detection alerts. Can we add a dashboard tile for fallback rate? :thumbsup:

maya (product): Yes — include dashboard + alert (fallback_rate > 1% for 3m) as acceptance criteria for alerts. Also add: runbook must include postmortem checklist items for communicating with affected customers.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by alex (eng) for branch prd/canary-protections at 2026-06-03T15:40:12Z

alex (eng): I'll open the RFC now and tag folks. Draft acceptance criteria will be included. Thanks all — I'll push the initial rollback automation PR and link here.

maya (product): Thanks — please add the customer impact statement in the RFC (who was affected, ETA for mitigation). We'll reconvene after RFC review. :calendar:
